items.title: I am writing to complain about the quality of the repairs to the curbs along Albemarle Gate and Sackville Approach. In particular, there is a repair at the rear of my house which can only be described as appalling. There was a loose stone block and I took great care over the last year to keep it safe with a view to replacing myself. However, the team repairing the damaged curb simply took away the stone and replaced with a very poorly applied lump of concrete. They also didn’t sweep the local area or remove a loose piece of stone that they dislodged during the repair. It seems from looking at other patch repairs in the area that the quality is very poor and not giving value to the Council, or local tax payers. I would welcome an inspection by a member of the council team and request that the repair be carried out properly.
